notes: The ASV's italic thy word is the only added material; the two אֶל prepositions rendered toward and the third against are each aligned as written.

Partition verified. The added unit is right: הַטֵּף carries no object morpheme and no suffix stands anywhere in the clause, so neither *thy* nor *word* is licensed (rules 17, 30, 44).
